title: 前白宫副国安顾问：停火协议细节明确，伊朗可获石油收入
speaker: Ben Rhodes

segments.en: We can add other modifiers to that, fragile, tenuous. I look at the reporting overnight, I'm more sure.
segments.zh: 我们可以加上其他修饰词：脆弱、不稳定。我看了昨晚的报道，更加确信了。

segments.en: An unnamed U.S. official told CNN after the U.S. strikes at the action did not constitute a return to major combat operations for now.
segments.zh: 一位匿名美国官员在美军打击后告诉CNN，这些行动目前不构成重返大规模作战。

segments.en: Is this still a ceasefire as you see it, given what we've seen play out over the last three or four days?
segments.zh: 在你看来，鉴于过去三四天发生的情况，这还算停火吗？

segments.en: I think it is in the sense that the terms are pretty clear, right?
segments.zh: 我认为是的，因为条款相当明确，对吧？

segments.en: I mean, when we actually see text or get briefed on text of what's in the agreement, there's not a lot of dispute about what's in there.
segments.zh: 当我们真正看到协议文本或听取简报时，对内容并没有太多争议。

segments.en: And it involves Iran being able to get revenue on the front end through the sale of oil and the wave of sanctions on those sales in return for opening the straight in the end of the blockade and then some period of negotiation.
segments.zh: 协议涉及伊朗前期通过出售石油获得收入，并解除对这些销售的制裁，以换取开放海峡、结束封锁，然后进入一段谈判期。

segments.en: I think part of what is going on, David, is that the posturing around what's in the terms of the deal is upsetting the ability to implement the deal and get into negotiations.
segments.zh: 我认为部分问题在于，围绕协议条款的姿态影响了协议执行和进入谈判的能力。
